title: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil engineer or civil drafter (Wagga Wagga / Griffith NSW)
content_text: Xeros Piccolo Consulting Engineers is a Riverina multidisciplinary consultancy with offices in Wagga Wagga and Griffith, delivering civil and structural design, drafting, construction monitoring and site inspections for residential, commercial and industrial projects. Xeros Piccolo Consulting Engineers welcomes expressions of interest from students, graduates, and experienced professionals across engineering and drafting disciplines. Whether you are seeking a specific role or wish to be considered for future opportunities, we encourage you to complete the form below and attach your résumé.
apply_instructions: No junior civil vacancy verified as open for Marc. Careers page Expressions of Interest form welcomes students, graduates and drafting disciplines including Civil Drafter and Civil Engineer.
